title: How a Man of God Waits for a Wife Without Wasting the Wait
caption:
The ache of being single is real. What you do with it decides who she meets.

God first. Build the man. Get planted with brothers. Guard your eyes. The wait stops being wasted.

Send this to a brother who's still waiting.

#faith #godlyman #singleseason #christianmen #discipline
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
